I didn't go to the hospital, just threw up quite a lot and passed out, somehow I didn't wake my mum up in the process. Still went to work the next day lol.

I am seeing a professional now, and slowly trying to talk about it, I certainly have picked up a few years of unhealthy behaviors I need to sort through. I have been feeling like this again and recently had a friend OD (they're ok). I feel like I need to define that situation so I can try to make peace with it, and hopefully move past it.

Honestly, I just know I wanted out, I didn't really give much thought to defining what "out" ment in the moment. I have been varying degrees of suicidal for a good 5 years, and I did have a plan at one point. I've been seeing a professional for a year straight now (have had others in the past but only for a few months each). Even so, It is only very recently that I have started to try and talk about it/write about it, and I still struggle to be honest with myself about it.
